item.title: Meduza: Alexey Baykov, co-founder of Hydra, the world’s largest online drug market, gets 10 years in prison — a term usually handed to low-level dealers
item.description: On November 17, Perm’s Kirovsky District Court sentenced Alexey Baykov, one of the creators of Hydra, the world’s largest online drug marketplace. Baykov had struck a plea deal with investigators and received 10 years instead of the 18 years in a high-security penal colony that prosecutors had sought. Before sentencing, confidential records from his criminal case were posted on the darknet, where an unidentified writer accused Baykov of paying 600 million rubles in bribes to law enforcement…
